newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Army sergeant found guilty of rape.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Army sergeant found guilty of rape.

text.p: A military jury on Tuesday found U.S. Army Staff Sgt. Delmar Simpson guilty of at least one count of rape.

The six-member panel deliberated for 31 hours over five days following a 10-day trial, the most prominent case in a major sex scandal at the Aberdeen Proving Ground's Ordnance Centre and School. The verdict was being read out in court.
Simpson, 32, faced 19 counts of rape and 35 other counts. A sentencing hearing was slated to follow directly after the verdicts were announced.
Simpson could face a life sentence for rape convictions. He had earlier pleaded guilty to 11 counts of consensual sex and five counts of propositioning.
Defence attorney Frank Spinner said last Friday that Simpson, who did not testify during the trial, would likely address the jury during sentencing.
